The fine print, up front

Martys is a DCCA — that’s the business model, not a footnote. It works under its own name from Central Texas, keeps a witnessed record of every job, and cites sources for every research claim.

This is a new practice. Settled revenue to date is $0, so there are no testimonials and no client counts on this page — there’s nothing honest to put there yet. Early clients get introductory fixed prices and a DCCA who treats every job like it’s the reference it will become.

Guardrails that don’t bend: no fake reviews, no posting without your approval, no invented facts in research. If a job needs something outside the board, you’ll hear that plainly instead of getting a confident guess.
